scenes.say: Formula E's new era starts a month later. The first Gen4 race goes to Mexico City, not Jeddah.
The Jeddah double-header on December eighteenth and nineteenth moves to April sixteenth and seventeenth.
The reason is the conflict in the Middle East. The series pointed to the situation in the region and logistics.
Mexico City now opens the season on January sixteenth. It was originally round three.
Jeddah takes Sanya's April weekend, and the China race moves two weeks earlier, to April third.
It's still twenty-one races: eight double-headers and five single races.
Formula One, meanwhile, is still heading to the Middle East: Qatar at the end of November, Abu Dhabi in early December.
Check race times in your own time zone on LapRadar.

title: Formula E postpones Jeddah: the Gen4 era now starts in Mexico City on 16 January
